formulas.rms_shape_displacement: sqrt(sum_i sum_j((q_i2j-q_i1j)^2)/(5n)); not the mean of participant RMS distances

icc_a1.degenerate: undefined if fewer than two frequency observations, active nonfinite value, no variation, or denominator numerically zero at 64*epsilon relative tolerance
icc_a1.finite_sample_statistic: two-way mixed-effects single-measure absolute-agreement ICC(A,1) across the two designated occasion columns
icc_a1.frequency_weights: nonnegative integer multiplicities exactly equivalent to row expansion; zero-weight rows removed first
icc_a1.target: sample-level between-person agreement for level under the selected cohort, occasions, task set, transformation, and complete-case rule; not individual-profile reliability

optional_quantities.profile_correlation: RETAIN descriptive participant distribution; undefined for flat/near-flat profiles; no interval
optional_quantities.scatter: DEFER because it does not materially answer the frozen primary question and lacks a validated uncertainty design
optional_quantities.vector_trace_association: DEFER because B3-R did not evaluate this endpoint and its empirical role is incremental

primary.complete_case: all five supported finite coordinates at both selected occasions

reporting.multiplicity_adjustment: not applicable; all planned outputs retained without significance selection
reporting.units: dimensionless internal-reference coordinate units; RMS has coordinate units; ICC is unitless

resampling.p2: one target multiplicity vector shared with P3; fixed frozen coordinates
resampling.p3: linked target analysis/reference multiplicities; paired visits; original frozen folds; all held-out copies excluded; one auxiliary multiplicity draw shared across represented folds; fit only represented folds; remove zero-weight identities before reductions; refit authorized raw reference records
resampling.target_and_auxiliary_roles: sample independently within original roles, conditioning on observed role membership and frozen cohort/fold assignment

research_question: How do observed five-task longitudinal profile agreement and change depend on reference estimation, scaling, support restrictions, and quality-control/pair selection in the selected Penn LEAD sample?

resume.atomic_write: temporary file then replace; never overwrite a validated completed draw

secondary_interval_policy: No intervals for 45-, 41-, or M1-supported subsets in v1; reference membership, subset selection, changing n, physical-source linkage, and target population require a separately frozen design.

sensitivities.rule: same primary identities and pairs; M0/SD
identical 42 M1-supported pairs; no M0 fallback
strict-V reselected occasions; four changed pair definitions remain explicit

uncertainty.P4: deferred: incremental empirical purpose not justified
